headline: Only 4% of Singapore fintechs say new revenue is AI's top benefit
body: A report from the Singapore Fintech Association (SFA), Airwallex and Kapronasia surveyed 100 fintech leaders in Singapore. Only 4 percent of respondents name new revenue as AI's biggest benefit, while lower operating costs were the most common answer at 41 percent.
note: Most of these firms have deployed AI, and how they manage their own data was the most common barrier to wider use, cited by 63 percent of respondents.

figure.label: of surveyed fintechs name new revenue as top AI benefit

evidence.text: More than eight in ten Singapore fintechs surveyed have deployed artificial intelligence (AI), yet only 4 percent of respondents name new revenue as its biggest benefit.
The Singapore Fintech Association (SFA) , Airwallex and Kapronasia released the report, The AI Inflection Point: Rewiring Fintech , on 18 November at the Singapore Fintech Festival.
They surveyed 100 fintech leaders in Singapore and interviewed 10 senior industry practitioners.
Lower operating costs were the most common answer at 41 percent.
How firms manage their own data was the most common barrier to expanding AI use, cited by 63 percent of respondents.
